title: Operation Highjump

tellings.quote: So in 1946, for whatever reason, we United States Navy sent a huge expedition of ships to Antarctica.

plain: In 1946, the researcher and philosopher Jason Jorjani says, the US Navy "for whatever reason" sent "a huge expedition of ships to Antarctica," an operation known as Highjump. He tells this to Michels in an episode about what he calls Hitler's secret UFO programme, and he names the polar explorer Richard Byrd in connection with it. He gives no source. The phrase "for whatever reason" hints that he thinks the mission's real purpose went beyond what was said at the time.
